persona: University student applying for graduate/intern roles with coursework and short-internship evidence, limited time and no polished CV

rubric.interpretation: Observed guest student journey; limitations and material findings are explicitly recorded.

findings.title: Explicitly academic work receives a direct professional-experience finding
findings.task: Use original source from student.md and boundary vacancy C; inspect professional Power BI requirement.
findings.expected: Related/manual review with preserved academic context; this passage must not establish professional experience.
findings.actual: Direct wording found quotes the class-project passage including 'This was academic work, not professional employment.' No academic tag appears; summary has two direct and zero review findings.
findings.acceptance: Recognize coursework/class/academic section context and attached disclaimers; explicit professional/commercial/employment requirement cannot be direct using only academic evidence. Preserve specific quote; generic task may still be direct with academic context; real employment remains usable.

findings.title: Generic team overlap produces unhelpful partial task match
findings.task: Check vacancy B with sanitized source plus added methods example; inspect 'Create charts for a small research team.'
findings.expected: No partial task support based solely on 'team'; no passage/manual review unless useful task/object evidence exists.
findings.actual: Related passage and 'CV covers part' cite coordinating coding-club workshops with a team of two volunteers.
findings.acceptance: Exact fixture no longer treats team alone as partial task evidence; real chart-creation and specific tool/object evidence remain discoverable.

findings.title: Student guidance is lost on help return while draft survives
findings.task: Start /check?audience=student via homepage, reach review, visit help/walkthroughs, return via header Free CV check at /check.
findings.expected: Restore selected audience guidance with current draft or expose a convenient audience selector.
findings.actual: Sanitized CV and vacancy restore, but University student guidance panel disappears.
findings.acceptance: Retain student guidance for same active draft across help return and consented refresh without changing facts or assigning it to unrelated new checks.
